critical_items.note: Issuer, state, incorporation date and intermediary are confirmed from the Form C XML and the Form C PDF.
Common Stock, per the Form C XML and Form C. It is not a SAFE or note. Held through a custodian with an irrevocable 10-year proxy to the Executive Chairman.

The Exhibit B Subscription Agreement (pages 53-63) is in the pack. The issuer's Certificate of Incorporation/Charter, which governs dividends, liquidation preference and stock rights, is not in the pack. The lock-up length differs between the Form C and the subscription agreement.
The price is $1.00 per share, set arbitrarily. There is no cap, discount or conversion in the offered common stock. The conversion price of the existing notes is not disclosed (A14).

Minimum $500. Intermediary fees are the greater of $15,000 or 6% above $100,000, plus a $7,500 onboarding fee and 2% in securities. Any investor-side fees are not stated; the user must confirm at approval.

Audited FY2025 and FY2024 statements (12/31/2025; auditor report dated 2026-06-11) are cited. The cash figure of June 18, 2026 is issuer-stated and unaudited. The XML long-term debt of 0 conflicts with the $50,704 of notes on the balance sheet, and the going-concern wording differs between the risk factors and the auditor's report.
No platform page, progress update or closing report is in the pack. Only the Form C deadline of 11-27-2026 is available, which is not proof that the offering is open.
